classification.difficultyReason: Uses parallel-line angles to prove similarity and completes a corresponding-side ratio.

content.prompt: Prove that $\triangle ABC$ is similar to $\triangle ADE$ and copy and complete the ratio statement.

spec.description: Nested triangles sharing A, with DE parallel to BC, AD=6, DB=2 and an unlabelled angle arc at A. Ordinary source blue strokes become house black.
spec.mathematics: D lies on AB, E lies on AC, AD:AB=6:8 and DE is parallel to BC.
spec.answerVisibility: All givens visible; no completed ratios.

answer.short: $\triangle ABC\sim\triangle ADE$ (AAA): the angle at $A$ is common and corresponding angles are equal because $DE\parallel BC$.
answer.worked:
$\angle BAC=\angle DAE$ (common angle).

$\angle ABC=\angle ADE$ and $\angle ACB=\angle AED$ (corresponding angles, $DE\parallel BC$).

Therefore $\triangle ABC\sim\triangle ADE$ (AAA).

$AB=6+2=8$.

Matching sides of similar triangles have equal ratios:

$$\frac{AB}{AD}=\frac{AC}{AE}=\frac86=\frac43.$$
